facts.title: Technology and safety principles
facts.text: GVAI Safety Systems researches strain, stability and recoverability signals, and tests proposed agent actions against explicit invariants and observed effects. Policy, permissions and shutdown authority should remain outside the governed agent. Runtime governance is experimental; these principles are not safety guarantees.

facts.title: What is available?
facts.text: Runtime governance is experimental. GVAI Intelligence is in development. The public website offers information and a recorded prototype demonstration, not live monitoring or an operational safety service. No production readiness, uptime or certification claim is established by this approved fact set.

facts.title: Advisory pilot
facts.text: The invite-only advisory pilot accepts expressions of interest. Access requires operator approval and operational validation. Advisory ALLOW, QUALIFY and BLOCK recommendations use caller-supplied telemetry and reported effects; they do not authorize or stop execution. The website does not activate access, signup or checkout.

facts.title: Pricing
facts.text: Paid subscriptions are not available according to the verified public homepage baseline. No approved public price is included in this fact set. Contact GVAI to discuss current evaluation terms; do not infer pricing from development branches or examples.

facts.title: Setup and evaluation plans
facts.text: Start by discussing a non-sensitive use case with GVAI. Before approved pilot access, agree a finite evaluation allowance, expiry and project scope. An operator provisions tenant and project access and arranges private one-time key delivery. No unlimited access or automatic renewal is offered. Never submit credentials or confidential operational information to this assistant.

facts.title: GVAI Intelligence direction
facts.text: GVAI Intelligence is a future platform direction with separate internal and customer identities, tenant boundaries, tool permissions and independent enforcement. Business and government tools are planned. The website does not provide production login, tenant services or customer data processing.

facts.title: Documentation and demonstration
facts.text: Read the repository threat model for the experimental boundary and limitations. The recorded prototype walkthrough is offline evidence, not a live worker or model demonstration, and does not establish production safety guarantees.
